title: Change in Frasers Logistics & Commercial Asset Management Pte. Ltd's position in Frasers Logistics & Commercial Trust
body: Frasers Logistics & Commercial Asset Management Pte. Ltd executed a transaction for 5,349,057 shares of Frasers Logistics & Commercial Trust. This increases their holdings from 18,248,132 to 23,597,189 shares.

circumstances_desc: The REIT Manager has announced the issuance of 4,282,414 Units payable to FLCAM as payment of 75% of the management fees in respect of FLCT, FCOT and FS1T and 1,066,643 Units payable to FLT Australia Management, a wholly-owned subsidiary of FLCAM, as payment of 75% of management fees in respect of the HAUT. Each of FLCAM and FLT Australia Management has nominated FPITH II to receive the Units payable to it and has received cash in consideration for such nomination. Table 1. title: Wong Kim Yin was awarded shares of Sembcorp Industries Ltd
